name: paren
description:
The framing parenthesis, as the reference set draws it: a display-size glyph in PARADISE, never sunflower — sunflower measures 1.71:1 on cream, a glyph nobody can read, while paradise is 3.93:1, which clears the 3:1 a shape needs at the display sizes these sit at. Inline, not a flex child: as flex items the parens wrapped onto their own lines above and below the sentence, which reads as a mistake rather than a frame.

Contexts re-ink it where the ground changes — the cost overlay's scrim takes `secondary-edge`, one step lighter on the same ramp, because paradise on that scrim measures 2.50:1.

a11y.note: Always `aria-hidden`: the parens frame the sentence visually and add nothing when read aloud.
